summary.en: A line of text boils into grain under a selection box and the cloud condenses into a larger mark that sets sharp and glowing.
summary.zh: 一行字在选区框里沸腾成颗粒，颗粒云急速凝聚成更大的短字标，位移归零后清晰发光定格。

fits: A long line that boils down to one word: a launch line into the product name, a sentence into its keyword, at the end of a film.
notFor: Text the viewer still has to read when it starts moving (the line is legible only in the first 0.26 s); two texts that do not name the same thing.

overlaps.note: characters cycle in place to the next text; grain-condense dissolves the whole line into a cloud and condenses a different, larger word
dots that spell a number from the font; grain-condense is a displacement of the type itself, no particles to count
tiles of a poster gather and fly apart in 3D; grain-condense is fine grain in place

intent.en: A long line boils down to the one word that matters, so the viewer feels the message distilled into the name.
intent.zh: 一长句沸腾凝缩成最要紧的那个词，让观众感到信息被提纯成了名字。

content.en: Two texts that name the same thing: a line (≤ 40 chars) and a shorter mark (≤ 16 chars, usually the product name).
content.zh: 指同一件事的两段字：一句（≤ 18 字）和一个更短的字标（≤ 6 字，通常是产品名）。

fits.zh: 片尾把一句宣言收成产品名，或把一句话收成关键词。

notFor.zh: 起动时还得读的字（句子只有前 0.26 秒能读）；指的不是同一件事的两段字。

pairs.note: the condensed name can hand over to the full lock-up with its mark

en: Both texts must say the same thing; a swap between unrelated words reads as a glitch.
The line is unreadable once the boil starts: show it on screen before this move.
zh: 两段字必须是同一件事，不相干的字互换像故障。
一沸腾句子就读不了：让它在这一动之前先在画面上停够。

upstream.name: 文字砂化凝聚
upstream.summary: 整行字爆裂成沸腾颗粒噪点并浮现斜纹选区框，噪点云急速凝聚成更大号发光短字标，位移衰减归零定格
upstream.use: 收尾"XX. Now Live"式上线宣告；长句信息压缩成品牌短标的能量聚合拍
upstream.energy: 中高（短促、一次性的能量脉冲，天然的 outro 卡点）
